_comment_crons: Both crons run once a day, which is all the Vercel Hobby plan allows.
send-event-reminders is scheduled at 13:00 UTC = 17:00 Dubai. That time is
chosen deliberately: every event email is scheduled for 16:45 Dubai, so a
single daily run at 17:00 picks all of them up 15 minutes later — including
the 'one hour before' emails, which then land roughly an hour before an
18:00 session. Moving this time without also moving the sendAt values in
events-data.ts will cause the hour-before emails to be skipped as too late.
